{{Clue info

==Transporation==
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run south-west.
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Toby]].
*[[Chronicle]] and run north.
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to the [[Champions' Guild]] and go north.
